verdict: Lead volume surged 5x this week while cost per lead held flat.
narrative: This period delivered 27 leads at $10.39 each — and the real story is in the last 7 days, where lead volume jumped +475% and spend rose +461% without meaningfully raising that cost per lead (-2.39%). The efficiency held at scale, which confirms the campaign is performing, not just spending. On the organic side, two of your Google Business Profile listings are generating impressions but converting to calls at very low rates, and we're working to improve those profiles so organic traffic pulls its weight alongside paid. One data connection for pipeline tracking is being restored; until it's back, we can't confirm every lead is moving through intake correctly, and we're treating that as a priority fix this week.
